title: NextJS 13 (latest) package not working in monorepos

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Output
labels.description: Related to the the output configuration option.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

    Operating System:
      Platform: darwin
      Arch: x64
      Version: Darwin Kernel Version 22.2.0: Fri Nov 11 02:08:47 PST 2022; root:xnu-8792.61.2~4/RELEASE_X86_64
    Binaries:
      Node: 16.13.1
      npm: 8.1.2
      Yarn: 1.22.19
      pnpm: 7.17.0
    Relevant packages:
      next: 13.1.3-canary.4
      eslint-config-next: 12.0.0
      react: 18.2.0
      react-dom: 18.2.0


### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

Standalone mode (output: "standalone")

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/JoeCollinsBJSS/next-monorepo-bug-reproduction/tree/main

### To Reproduce

Place Next 13 package into a monorepo with other next packages and apps (for example I've used the `api-routes-app` example, but this seems to occur with all next examples and basic apps - see repo attached for a simple recreation)
Run `pnpm install` and then (`./scripts/recreate.sh`) or the below:
```
#!/bin/bash

cd ./source/apps/app-collection/api-routes-app
pnpm run build
cp -r .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static
node .next/standalone/server.js
```
This will now error. The identical package and commands works if moved into it's own dir outside of a monorepo (eg, `cp -r . ~/api-routes-app` then running the above commands will have it successfully run).

### Expected Behavior

The app should run locally when running `node .next/standalone/server.js` in the package, as it does when the project is in it's own root dir
